description: This header file defines the interface for a throttling system in the lighttpd server, including functions for creating, updating, and managing throttle states and pools.
external_methods: void li_throttle_set(liWorker *wrk, liThrottleState *state, guint rate, guint burst)
guint li_throttle_query(liWorker *wrk, liThrottleState *state, guint interested, liThrottleNotifyCB notify_callback, gpointer data)
liThrottlePool* li_throttle_pool_new(liServer *srv, guint rate, guint burst)

methods.name: li_throttle_new
methods.description: Creates a new throttle state object.

methods.name: li_throttle_set
methods.description: Configures a throttle state with specified rate and burst size.

methods.name: li_throttle_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a throttle state.

methods.name: li_throttle_query
methods.description: Queries the throttle state and potentially notifies when throttle conditions change.

methods.name: li_throttle_update
methods.description: Updates the throttle state with used tokens or bandwidth.

methods.name: li_throttle_pool_new
methods.description: Creates a new throttle pool associated with a server.

methods.name: li_throttle_pool_acquire
methods.description: Acquires a permit from the throttle pool.

methods.name: li_throttle_pool_release
methods.description: Releases a permit back to the throttle pool.

methods.name: li_throttle_add_pool
methods.description: Adds a throttle pool to a throttle state.

methods.name: li_throttle_remove_pool
methods.description: Removes a throttle pool from a throttle state.

methods.name: li_throttle_waitqueue_cb
methods.description: Callback for worker waitqueue setup related to throttling.
